summary: Lionheart Samui is a Muay Thai and fitness camp in Ban Tai, Koh Samui, offering Muay Thai, weight loss and fitness packages for all levels with accommodation options and an onsite cafe.

facts.label: Levels
facts.value: All levels, from beginners to professionals
facts.quote: We accept all levels at our camp, from fitness enthusiasts and beginner trainees to seasoned professionals

facts.label: Package length
facts.value: 1, 2 and 4 week options, longer stays on request
facts.quote: You can book your package for as long as you like

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.value: Range of accommodation for different budgets
facts.quote: We offer a range of accommodation to suit all budgets

facts.label: Gym hours
facts.quote: The gym is open between 8am and 8pm.

facts.label: Taxes and fees
facts.value: Prices are subject to 7% tax and 3% transaction fee
facts.quote: Prices are subject to 7% government tax and 3% transaction fee.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Moo 5, Bantai, Mae Nam, 200 m from Ban Tai beach
facts.quote: 32/8, Moo 5, Bantai, Mae Nam, Koh Samui District, Surat Thani 84330
